blurb: A flying troop carrier for six, the hover carrier: a pilot in the open cockpit, a door gunner on the deck and four on its benches

notes.model: Hover carrier (Meshy, owned: the owner's own model, owner 2026-11-16: "I made it on Meshy"; the owner's Drive, Meshy_AI_hover_carrier_topdown_1116164125_texture.glb; content/guns.json vehicles/hover_carrier.glb, 2026-11-16): an olive and white armoured hover carrier, 9.6 m long (the old box's length), 4.74 m wide and 2.38 m tall, built 10,000 triangles with a 2,479 one from 40 m and a 1024 px colour map. An open cockpit at the nose (one seat on the centre line behind a console), and behind its bulkhead an open sunken deck 6 m long between the hull's sides, a bench along each side of its back two-thirds (three cushions a side) and a rail over each side. The Quaternius Imperial it replaced is the fallback (vehicles/dropship.glb).
notes.half: Fitted to the hull (2026-11-16; measured on the model, slices of its triangles; the mount's frame is the model's plus the 0.35 m it hovers): 4.7 m wide (the box was 4.0), 9.6 m long (unchanged), and up to the hull's sides, 1.7 m (unchanged). Over the box: the side rails (to 2.4 m, thin bars) and the cockpit's shell and bulkhead (2.2-2.7 m), not solid, like the Hauler's fins. The deck inside is open: its floor is 0.65 m up, so a rider is inside the box, and shots reach riders through the open hull (openHull) as on any open vehicle.
notes.seats: Measured on the model: the cockpit's seat on the centre line, its cushion 1.5 m up at z 2.65 (the backrest behind it to 2.7 m at z 2.0-2.4, the footwell 1.05 m up at z 3.0-3.4, the console to 2.1 m at z 3.8-4.4). The deck's floor 0.65 m up from z 1.75 back to -4.3, between the hull's sides at x ±2.0 (1.65 m up, rails to 2.4); each bench from z -0.2 to -4.0, its front edge at x ±1.0, its cushion 1.2 m up and its backrest to 1.56 m at x ±1.6. The pilot sits in the cockpit (legDrop the default 0.45 to the footwell). The door gunner stands on the deck's open front (z 0.8), eye 2.25 m up: over the sides (1.65) and the tailgate (2.34), and can duck under them; the cockpit's bulkhead (2.7 m) hides a narrow wedge dead ahead, which the pilot's view covers. The four riders sit on the benches facing in (backs to the hull, cushions at x ±1.3, z -1.0 and -3.0, feet on the floor 0.55 m below); their seated eyes (2.2 m) clear the sides. Roles, the gun and its all-round arc unchanged. They stood on the old model's flat top.
notes.enterRadius: 4.5 m, unchanged: the hull reach (sim/mounts.ts enterReach, ENTER_HULL_REACH) lets a player in from anywhere along its sides, nose and tail; the wider hull (2.35 m a side) is inside the radius at its middle.
notes.cockpitEye: A seated head height over the cockpit's cushion (2.45 m up, a little forward): over the console (2.1 m) and between the cockpit's side pods (2.2-2.5 m); the nose is low in the view.
